items.title: Dichotomy for linear systems in characteristic p: generically etale pencil or small-degree system on the Frobenius twist
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file curves.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma dichotomizes any linear system in characteristic p (statement lines 2915-2926): either a generically etale pencil exists, or the Frobenius twist X^{(p)} carries a system of degree at most d/p. The proof (lines 2928-2962) runs: pencil test via the unwind proposition, the all-quotients factorization through X^{(p)} with extension over the normal curve, pullback of O(1), and the degree identity deg(L') = p deg(N). Every step is present with no omissions. H3: the Frobenius factorization mechanism is genuine characteristic-p geometry.
